globalProperty.description: This configuration specifies the default date format pattern used for displaying and parsing dates in the user interface and API responses. The value should follow Java SimpleDateFormat pattern notation. Common patterns include 'dd/MM/yyyy' (day/month/year), 'MM-dd-yyyy' (month-day-year), 'yyyy-MM-dd' (ISO format), or 'dd MMM yyyy' (e.g., 25 Dec 2023). This property helps maintain consistent date display formatting across different Bahmni modules and ensures proper date parsing for locale-specific requirements.
